title: Ember Serpent
description: Steer the serpent across the grid, collect energy cores, and build speed combos without hitting walls.
controls: Arrow Keys / WASD to steer · Space to pause

title: Cinder Breaker
description: Shatter layered armored brick formations with angled paddle deflections and rising ball velocity.
controls: Mouse or A/D / Left-Right Arrows to move paddle

title: 2048 Forge
description: Slide matching tiles across the 4x4 matrix to forge the 2048 core with full move undo support.
controls: Arrow Keys / WASD or Swipe to slide tiles

title: Solar Dodger
description: Pilot your delta craft through asteroid barrages while harvesting high-value solar orbs in the arena.
controls: Mouse Pointer or WASD / Arrows to pilot

title: Volt Thruster
description: Thread industrial reactor pillars with crisp one-button thrust physics and responsive momentum.
controls: Space / Up Arrow / Click to fire thrusters

title: Mine Sweep
description: Clear the 9x9 hazard grid by deducing hidden mines from adjacent tile counts as fast as possible.
controls: Left-click to reveal · Right-click or Flag Mode to mark
